title: Add local install and update workflow
description: Add a developer-facing script and README guidance for building and deploying wtp into the user's PATH during local development, including how to update the installed binary after source changes.

comments.author: Codex
comments.message: Added local install scripts for shell and PowerShell, documented install/update usage in the README, installed the binary to /home/matty/.local/bin/wtp, and verified with go test ./... plus a direct command run from the installed binary.
